votes.motion: Approve the LBA Consent Agenda (setting public hearing dates of May 17, 2022 and June 7, 2022 for the Capital Projects Fund budget of the Local Building Authority for Fiscal Year 2022-23)
votes.description: Sets public hearing dates to accept comment and consider adopting the LBA Capital Projects Fund budget for FY 2022-23, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Local Building Authority and convene as the City Council
votes.description: Formally closes the LBA board meeting and transitions the body into the Salt Lake City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of March 22, 2022
votes.description: Formally approves the recorded minutes of the Council's March 22, 2022 work session meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the Public Lands Twenty-Year Master Plan (Reimagine Nature) ordinance to a future date for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the City's Twenty-Year Public Lands Master Plan and defers Council action to a future meeting date.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on redistricting City Council district boundaries and refer the item to a future date for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed resolution to change City Council district boundaries based on 2020 Census results and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Defer the Stealth Towers Text Amendments ordinance to a future date for action
votes.description: Postpones Council action on the proposed zoning ordinance amendment that would allow stealth wireless telecommunication facilities taller than 35 feet in the Public Lands zoning district.

votes.motion: Defer the Zoning Map Amendment at Western Gardens (550 South 600 East) to a future date for action
votes.description: Postpones Council action on the proposed rezoning of 550 South 600 East from CN to FB-UN2 to facilitate multifamily residential redevelopment.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 10 of 2022, adopting the one-year action plan for Fiscal Year 2023 and allocating CDBG, ESG, HOME, and HOPWA funds
votes.description: Approves the Mayor's funding recommendations and the FY 2022-23 One-Year Annual Action Plan for federal HUD grants, including Community Development Block Grant, HOME, Emergency Solutions Grant, and HOPWA funding, along with an Interlocal Agreement with HUD.

votes.motion: Partially adopt Ordinance 16 of 2022 amending the FY 2021-22 final budget for Item E-10 Community Grants Program ($4M from ARPA), contingent upon following the Community Recovery Committee process
votes.description: Amends the FY 2021-22 budget to allocate $4 million in ARPA funds for a one-time Community Grants Program ($2M for business assistance grants and $2M for nonprofit assistance grants), contingent on the Community Recovery Committee process.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 17 of 2022, amending Salt Lake City Code Chapters 2.07 and 2.20 to establish the Community Grant Program and create the Community Recovery Committee
votes.description: Creates a new City board to oversee distribution of $4 million in ARPA funds through a one-time Community Grants Program, split between business and nonprofit assistance grants.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 18 of 2022, approving a $100,000 loan for The Current Exchange from the Economic Development Loan Fund
votes.description: Approves a $100,000 EDLF loan to The Current Exchange at 1159 S. Richard Street, a business that restores classic automobiles by replacing combustion engines with electric motors.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 19 of 2022, approving a $100,000 loan for Mindful Living Wellness Center from the Economic Development Loan Fund
votes.description: Approves a $100,000 EDLF loan to Mindful Living Wellness Center at 1592 South 1100 East, a professional services business offering float therapy, yoga, meditation, and other wellness services.

votes.motion: Adopt the City Council Consent Agenda (items J1–J20, including setting public hearing dates and approving multiple board appointments)
votes.description: Approves a package of consent items including setting public hearing dates for several budget and zoning matters, and approving appointments to the Planning Commission, Business Advisory Board, Human Rights Commission, and Accessibility and Disability Commission.
